rows.ui_disposition: Reuse source-neutral canonical Money/Currency formatting, Wallet rates and Search/List owners; do not create Telegram-derived currency UI/runtime owners.

rows.platform_differences: Qt locale/input-method currency discovery is platform-specific; monetary rounding, unavailable-rate, tiny-value and currency-priority semantics are platform-neutral.
